# Focus stacking per-lens flag branch

The branch that rejects lenses without the stacking flag; patching it out allows any lens.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x6065e5ec` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Inside fcs_check_focus_stacking_enable (0x6065e5d6). The earlier lens-type check is shared with eight other callers and is left alone.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): With the branch replaced by two no-ops, focus stacking runs with lenses outside the stock list. Source: [Focus stacking lens check patch](../sources/em5n.focus-patch.md).
